mentions.name: neely
mentions.description: Club & team management platform for amateur sports clubs in the DACH region, starting with youth handball. Aims to be the 'Google Workspace for clubs' — a better alternative to the widely used but unpopular incumbent SpielerPlus.
mentions.problem: The incumbent SpielerPlus is used by practically every handball team in Germany, yet coaches are unhappy with it, leaving a gap for a better club management solution.
mentions.audience: Amateur sports clubs in the DACH region, starting with youth handball teams and their coaches
mentions.source_excerpt: neely (https://neely.app) - club & team management for amateur sports clubs in the DACH region, starting with youth handball. I coach youth handball myself.
